purpose: Closes P3 §sec:pathc_caveats item (f) — BigAE-vs-IsolationForest 'high overlap' verification (R3+R4 Gemini-M1, R7 GEM-M3 multi-round deferral).
interpretation: BigAE-top-298 ∩ IF-top-9303 = 284 (95.3% of BigAE-top-298 are also IF-top-9303); expected under random-independence null = 2.98; enrichment 95.3x; hypergeometric two-sided p = 0.000e+00. This quantifies the §3.4 'high overlap' qualitative claim with a real empirical intersection number and statistical significance against the random-independence null.
